cross_cutting_finding.headline: A POSITIONING-SEAM PRIOR TAKES ITS SIGN FROM THE VENUE WHOSE BOOK IS AT THE EXTREME, BUT ITS SIZE FROM THE COMPLEX-LEVEL NET WoW. When the two disagree - one venue at a record short while the complex is covering - the prior keeps its sign and loses most of its size premium.
cross_cutting_finding.the_gap_in_the_brain_this_closes: boundary.seam_gap_up_prior_on_worsening_cot and positioning.covering_self_limiting_cot_wow_gate both fire on the NYMEX managed-money WoW ALONE. But their stated mechanism is 'shorts that still have to buy' - and shorts that have to buy live across the whole Henry Hub complex, not on one venue. The state serves ICE LD1 / PEN / basis / index on every single day of every block and NOT ONE PLAY IN THE BRAIN CONSUMES PEN. A raised the venue split as an observation; this makes it a QUANTITY with a rule.
cross_cutting_finding.the_rule_proposed: SIGN from the extreme venue - that is where the crowding is and where forced buying gets priced. SIZE from the sum of managed-money WoW across the complex (NYMEX futures + ICE LD1 + ICE PEN), contract-size-normalized. Agreement (both worsening) = the seam quantum stands at its class value. DISAGREEMENT (extreme venue worsening, complex flat or covering) = keep the SIGN, take the seam quantum at or below the walk's measured floor. The mechanism is plain: a crowded book with no incremental complex-level fuel is a spring that is already partly discharged somewhere you were not looking.
cross_cutting_finding.no_free_constants: The rule is a SIGN comparison between two already-published quantities plus the existing class band. Nothing is tuned and no threshold is introduced. The one input it needs and cannot get is contract-size metadata for the ICE books - declared below as a build item, not smuggled as an assumption.
cross_cutting_finding.measured_on_g20: The 05-26 report is the designed instance. NYMEX MM went to net -134,426, 1y pctile 0.94 - the strongest trigger boundary.seam_gap_up_prior_on_worsening_cot has ever been handed - on a WoW of -38,123 (shorts +29,942, longs -8,181). In the SAME report ICE HH Penultimate MM covered 51,630 (net -194,553 -> -142,923; 1y pctile 38.68 -> 65.09, i.e. through its own median) and LD1 shed 7,083 of length. Naive lot-sum: +6,424, the complex covered. Size-adjusted for the quarter-sized ICE contracts: about -27,000 NYMEX-equivalent, the complex shortened but ~30% less than the headline. DISAGREEMENT under either basis. Prediction: the 06-01 seam gap comes in AT OR BELOW the walk's measured positioning-seam quantum of +580 despite the strongest-ever NYMEX trigger. My +300 is that prediction.
cross_cutting_finding.falsifier: If 06-01 gaps materially ABOVE +580 - say beyond +800 - on a complex that covered or barely shortened, the complex-net SIZE arm is wrong and must be withdrawn in favour of the venue-only reading, not excused. Conversely, if the sign fails entirely (a DOWN gap), that falsifies the parent seam play on its best instance, not this addendum - the two failures are separable and should be scored separately.
cross_cutting_finding.how_it_composes_with_A: A's cross-cutting finding is a CONSUMPTION test on the D-1 post-publication phase flow: does the phase net CROSS to the publication's implied side (repriced, prior extinguished) or merely DECAY toward zero (deceleration, prior live)? That answers WHETHER the prior survives the session. Mine answers HOW BIG it can be once it does. They are orthogonal and they compose into a two-question seam procedure: is it live (A's phase-crossing test), and how much fuel is behind it (complex-net WoW). Both are open-time, non-price and BLIND-AVAILABLE - both sit in exactly the slot the price mask leaves empty, where the brain currently has only refine-side gates.
cross_cutting_finding.n_and_honesty: n=1 seam for the disagreement arm (this one). The agreement arm has G19's two seams, where NYMEX and the complex were not checked against each other at all, so they are only retrospectively consistent, not confirming. Honestly thin, declared as such. Rides G21+.

secondary_finding_degradation_has_three_.statement: The group-wide 'the frozen blocks are degraded' warning treats one label as one failure mode. It is three, and each takes a different response. (1) EXPIRY-KEYED frozen fields (squeeze_watch, days_to_*_expiry, opex dates) have a computable CROSSOVER DATE and are TRUE until it and FALSE after - A's F3. Response: compute the crossover from the live calendar and use the field on the correct side of it. (2) SLOW-STATE frozen fields (curve_regime, curve slope, storage phase) have no crossover event and stay usable well past their vintage when independently corroborated. Response: retain, and name the corroborating channel. (3) NULL fields (vol_regime.value across all of g20) are neither true nor false - they carry no content at all. Response: WIDEN THE BAND, never shift the p50, and never let a class band silently stand in for the missing vol band.
secondary_finding_degradation_has_three_.why_it_matters: Each wrong response costs differently. Treating (1) as (2) sizes a structural gap off a dead contract - the trap the state actively sets on 06-01. Treating (2) as (1) discards a good contango read for no reason. Treating (3) as either manufactures false precision, which is the one thing the data-quality doctrine explicitly forbids. In this block C, D and E issued the blanket warning, A found that it was wrong for 0525-0527, and I found that it is wrong in the other direction for curve_regime on every day. The blanket is wrong at both ends.
secondary_finding_degradation_has_three_.requires: open_time_only; every input is already in the state.
secondary_finding_degradation_has_three_.n: 3 field classes across one block, corroborated by four other specialists' independent reports of the same blocks.
